title: 15Oct-Valedictory & Nation Builder Awards - Youth
summary: The Youth Month celebrations culminated on 15th October with a Valedictory Event at Aryan High School, Girgaum which was graced by DG Rtn. Rajan Dua as Chief Guest and PDG Rtn. Nitin Mangaldas.
description:
The Youth Month celebrations culminated on 15th October with a Valedictory Event at Aryan High School, Girgaum which was graced by DG Rtn. Rajan Dua as Chief Guest and PDG Rtn. Nitin Mangaldas. The Valedictory Function celebrated the achievements of these young participants, with prizes and awards being presented to the winners. The occasion also recognised the dedication of outstanding educators through the Nation Builder Awards, honouring teachers who have made a lasting contribution to education. In addition, teachers and other individuals who have completed 25 years or more of dedicated service were felicitated for their commitment and contribution. Kudos Project Directors, Rtn. Shiv Prasad Khator and Rtn. Navnath Panaskar, for their dedicated efforts, commitment and team work in making Youth Month a grand success.
The programme received excellent coverage across both print and digital media, giving our Club’s work wonderful visibility and recognition. Attended by 13 Members.
